_note: Research file (not read by pages, except points and source link on the practice-set page): the structure of the exams our own practice sets follow, checked by scripts/check-pruefungen.mjs (same modules, same parts, same number of scored items per part). Ids are storage keys and stay: goethe-a1…c2 = DELE A1…C2 (goethe-a1 and goethe-c2 have no set in this file's sense: A1 lives in the start-deutsch-1 slot, C2 has no practice set), telc-* and testdaf = SIELE slots (exams-siele rewrites them; until then they still describe Trinity or the German exam). Only structure is described; no exam task or text is copied. Field conventions: minutes = paper time; items = scored items in OUR set, modelled on the best public information we found; plays = how often the recording is heard; points = marks where known. Every DELE fact here is 'to verify': see `unverified` in each entry and reports/exams-dele.md.
